newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila rail project seeks direct power link.
newsitem.headline: Manila rail project seeks direct power link.

text.p: The National Power Corp (Napocor) said on Friday the North Luzon Railways Corporation (NorthRail) is seeking a direct power connection for its Manila-Clark railway system in the northern island of Luzon.
Napocor said in a statement that NorthRail has started discussions for the supply of at least 20-megawatts.
Northrail wants an independent power line so it would not be dependent on the grids of rural electric cooperatives which are seen as unreliable.
The railway system will cover 100-kilometres from Metro Manila to Clark Field, a former American military airbase in Pampanga, north of the capital.

NorthRail is a joint venture of the state-run Bases Conversion Development Authority; Philipine National Railways; D.M. Consunji Inc, a unit of DMCI Holdings ; Metro Pacific Corp, Fort Bonifacio Development Corp, Euroma Development Corp and the Spanish Railway Group.
Napocor is the country's biggest electricity producer which the government plans to privatise.
